name: contenttraker
description: Fast local stdio adapter for account-aware ContentKeeper and digital asset operations.

interface.shortDescription: Use the exact authorized ContentKeeper through local stdio.
interface.longDescription: Codex launches this fast local stdio MCP adapter as a child process. The adapter calls the documented ContentTraker HTTPS JSON API, binds the account to issuer plus subject, resolves one live-authorized ContentKeeperId, and provides durable fail-closed per-worktree context plus structured digital asset tools. The package does not bundle or reuse the separate ContentTraker.com app connector.
defaultPrompt: Verify the authenticated ContentTraker account and list its authorized ContentKeepers.
Select and remember the exact authorized ContentKeeper for this worktree.
Create an approved idempotent draft digital asset in the resolved ContentKeeper.
